senses.definition: Able to be renewed; capable of renewal.
senses.example: Under the pilot project, the private sector will supply, install, operate and maintain e-vehicle charging stations; monitor and verify the energy efficiency, performance and savings in using renewable energy; and optimize the use of clean energy.

senses.definition: Sustainable; able to be regrown or renewed; having an ongoing or continuous source of supply.

senses.example: Klein diagnoses impressively what hasn’t worked. No more claptrap about fracked gas as a bridge to renewables. Enough already of the international summit meetings that produce sirocco-quality hot air, and nonbinding agreements that bind us all to more emissions.
